about: Canonical referral service taxonomy for the (service, location) model. Two levels: category -> service. Ids of the MODEL_SPEC_v1 gold services and icu are kept, except trauma_emergency, which is now the alias of trauma_care; 'aliases' lists the key used in cleaning/claims (lexicon.py, claims.parquet services column). 'coverage' is measured by build_coverage.py (facility counts over the 9,959 usable records; fields = procedure, capability, equipment, description, specialties). Urgency windows and required capabilities are standard clinical guidance summarised by the author for referral routing, not measured and not yet clinically reviewed. Hindi names are the author's and Marathi names are unverified; both need a native-speaker check before use in the app.

coverage_definition: facilities_any: usable records (of 9,959) with a matching claim sentence or a specialties value mapped to the service; facilities_2plus_fields: distinct fields among procedure, capability, equipment, description, specialties after dropping in-record echoes; states_any: distinct state_final; facilities_text_positive: text matches without a non-offer cue, not attributed to another facility and not a staff or directory sentence; facilities_text_2plus_fields: the same, in 2+ distinct text fields after dropping echoes; low_coverage: facilities_text_positive < 100 or facilities_text_2plus_fields < 100. Mentions are claims, not verified offers.

candidates_not_included.not_included_because: review candidate: few specialties values (7 facilities with palliativeCare); not a time-critical referral. Counts are in coverage.

inclusion_rule: A service is in the taxonomy when it is referral-relevant for intermediaries and either at least 20 usable records mention it, or IPHS 2022 expects it at public facility levels so a level prior over public facility lists can answer it (answer_mode 'prior'). low_coverage is computed on text evidence only: fewer than 100 facilities with positive text, or fewer than 25 with positive text in 2 or more text fields.
phrase_routing: name_phrases select the service. symptom_phrases select a route: search 'route' first among facilities that also meet 'requires', and show 'second_card' (the specialised service) next. Emergency symptoms route to emergency_24x7 so the nearest facility that can stabilise comes first; obstetric emergencies route to emergency_csection (CEmONC).

answer_modes.evidence_plus_prior: evidence, plus an IPHS level prior for public facilities the VF data rarely describes
answer_modes.prior: IPHS level prior over public facility lists; display_note shown

beds_total.note: hospital size; unit bed counts are service attributes

accreditation.note: multi-valued; external/nabh_accredited and external/laqshya_master are the stronger sources

hours_24x7.note: any 24x7 statement; per-service hours are in the service attributes

ownership.note: text hint only; facility_type and the public lists are the stronger sources
